en.expr.empty: The formula is empty. Write something like TC = 100 + 20Q.
en.expr.too_long: The formula is longer than {limit} characters.
en.expr.comma: A comma is not allowed here. Use a period for decimals (1.5) and no thousands separators.
en.expr.fullwidth: {char} is a full-width character. Type the ordinary {suggestion} instead.
en.expr.unexpected_char: {char} is not allowed in a formula. Use numbers, Q, P, + - * / ^ and brackets.
en.expr.number_too_large: {text} is too large; numbers may not exceed {limit:g}.
en.expr.unknown_name: {name} is not a variable or function this formula knows. Use {allowed}, or exp, ln, sqrt.
en.expr.unknown_name_product: {name} is read as one name. To multiply, write {suggestion}.
en.expr.function_needs_parens: {name} needs a bracket after it, as in {name}(Q).
en.expr.missing_operator: After {after} an operator is missing: put +, -, * or / before the next number.
en.expr.expected_operand: {found} cannot follow {previous}: a number or variable is expected here.
en.expr.ends_early: The formula ends after {previous}: a number or variable must follow.
en.expr.expected_rparen: A ) is missing to close the ( at position {opened}.
en.expr.too_deep: Brackets are nested more than {limit} levels deep.
en.expr.exponent_not_number: An exponent must be a plain number, for example Q^2 or Q^0.5.
en.expr.exponent_too_large: The exponent {value:g} is too large; use at most {limit:g}.
en.expr.equals_twice: Only one = is allowed, and it must follow the name of what is defined (TC, MC, P, ...).
en.expr.bad_head: {name} cannot be defined here. Start with one of: {allowed}.
en.expr.too_many_variables: A formula may use one variable only; this one uses {names}.
en.expr.not_finite: The formula has no finite value at {at}.
en.expr.integral_unsupported: No closed-form integral is known for this formula.
en.expr.derivative_unsupported: No derivative is known for this formula.
en.cost.error.bad_head: A cost formula defines one of {allowed}, not {name}.
en.cost.error.variable: A cost formula uses output Q (or q), not {names}.
en.cost.error.symbol: The output symbol must not be empty.
en.cost.error.fixed_conflict: fixed={fixed:g} disagrees with TC(0) = {value:g} in the formula. Leave fixed out, or make them equal.
en.cost.error.vc_not_zero: VC(0) = {value:g}, but variable cost is zero when nothing is produced. Move the constant into fixed=.
en.cost.error.negative_fixed: TC(0) = {value:g} is negative. Fixed cost is what you pay at zero output, so it cannot be below zero.
en.cost.error.undefined_at_zero: The formula has no value at zero output, so the fixed cost cannot be found. Write TC = ..., or give fixed=.
en.cost.error.coefficients: Give at least one coefficient, for example Cost.polynomial(200, 120, -18, 1).
en.cost.error.table: q and tc must be lists of the same length (at least two), with q starting at 0 and increasing.
en.cost.error.table_decreasing: Total cost in a table cannot fall as output rises.
en.cost.error.mc_not_positive: Marginal cost is not positive for {symbol} between {low:.4g} and {high:.4g} (MC = {mc:.4g} at {symbol} = {at:.4g}). Choose another output range or other coefficients.
en.cost.error.unbounded: At price {price:g} the firm would produce without limit, because marginal cost stays below the price.
en.cost.warning.no_fixed: No fixed cost was given, so FC = 0. Pass fixed= to set it.

zh-TW.expr.empty: 公式是空的，請寫成像 TC = 100 + 20Q 這樣。
zh-TW.expr.comma: 這裡不能用逗號。小數請用句點（1.5），數字中間不要加千分位。
zh-TW.expr.fullwidth: {char} 是全形字元，請改用一般的 {suggestion}。
zh-TW.expr.unexpected_char: 公式裡不能出現 {char}。請使用數字、Q、P、+ - * / ^ 與括號。
zh-TW.expr.unknown_name: {name} 不是這個公式認得的變數或函數。請使用 {allowed}，或 exp、ln、sqrt。
zh-TW.expr.unknown_name_product: {name} 會被當成一個名稱。要相乘請寫成 {suggestion}。
zh-TW.expr.missing_operator: {after} 後面少了運算符號：下一個數字前請加上 +、-、* 或 /。
zh-TW.expr.expected_operand: {previous} 後面不能接 {found}，這裡需要數字或變數。
zh-TW.expr.ends_early: 公式停在 {previous} 之後，後面還需要數字或變數。
zh-TW.expr.expected_rparen: 少了 ) 來結束位置 {opened} 的 (。
zh-TW.expr.exponent_not_number: 指數必須是一般的數字，例如 Q^2 或 Q^0.5。
zh-TW.expr.exponent_too_large: 指數 {value:g} 太大，最多只能用 {limit:g}。
zh-TW.expr.equals_twice: 只能有一個 =，而且前面要是被定義的名稱（TC、MC、P 等）。
zh-TW.expr.bad_head: 這裡不能定義 {name}。請以下列其中一個開頭：{allowed}。
zh-TW.expr.too_many_variables: 一個公式只能有一個變數，這個公式用了 {names}。
zh-TW.expr.not_finite: 在 {at} 時，公式沒有有限的值。
zh-TW.expr.integral_unsupported: 這個公式沒有已知的封閉形式積分。
zh-TW.expr.derivative_unsupported: 這個公式沒有已知的導數。
zh-TW.cost.error.bad_head: 成本公式只能定義 {allowed} 其中之一，不能是 {name}。
zh-TW.cost.error.variable: 成本公式用產量 Q（或 q），不能用 {names}。
zh-TW.cost.error.fixed_conflict: fixed={fixed:g} 與公式中的 TC(0) = {value:g} 不一致。請不要填 fixed，或讓兩者相等。
zh-TW.cost.error.vc_not_zero: VC(0) = {value:g}，但不生產時變動成本是零。請把常數項移到 fixed=。
zh-TW.cost.error.negative_fixed: TC(0) = {value:g} 是負的。固定成本是產量為零時要付的錢，不能小於零。
zh-TW.cost.error.undefined_at_zero: 公式在產量為零時沒有值，找不到固定成本。請寫成 TC = ...，或給 fixed=。
zh-TW.cost.error.coefficients: 至少要給一個係數，例如 Cost.polynomial(200, 120, -18, 1)。
zh-TW.cost.error.table: q 與 tc 必須是等長的清單（至少兩列），而且 q 從 0 開始遞增。
zh-TW.cost.error.table_decreasing: 表中的總成本不能隨產量增加而下降。
zh-TW.cost.error.mc_not_positive: {symbol} 在 {low:.4g} 到 {high:.4g} 之間邊際成本不是正的（{symbol} = {at:.4g} 時 MC = {mc:.4g}）。請換一個產量範圍或其他係數。
zh-TW.cost.error.unbounded: 價格為 {price:g} 時，廠商會無限制地生產，因為邊際成本一直低於價格。
zh-TW.cost.warning.no_fixed: 沒有給固定成本，所以 FC = 0。要設定請傳入 fixed=。
